title: pleurogramme pumila
intro: Pleurogramme pumila, commonly known as the 'Dwarf Rock Cap', is a species of liverwort, a small, non-vascular plant belonging to the family Pleuroziaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogramme pumila include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
